task_description: Build CarbonLedger AI - an enterprise-grade GHG (Scope 1/2/3) management SaaS platform compliant with ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, and IPCC standards. Next.js 15 + React 19 + Supabase + Drizzle ORM + TypeScript. Covers: project setup, database schema, calculation engine, auth/RBAC, dashboard UI, API routes, i18n, documentation, CI/CD, Docker, and compliance checklists.
